title: test_runs/<time>/meta.json
description: Where a run of the detectors over a test set came from.

moved.description: z distance a replay must push a row by to be an anomaly.

n.description: Rows an alarm looks back over. Each k from 1 to `n` is counted.

scores.description: The scores the detectors read, written as the test set was scored.

thresholds.description: The directory the thresholds came from.

onnx_files.description: The ONNX files the models scored as, as the scores record them. Null when the models scored in torch.

models.description: The directory the weights came from.

test_set.description: The test set the rows came from.

log_split.description: The log split the test set was drawn on.

grid.description: The grid the split was cut from.

min_speed.description: The speed a row had to exceed to be counted.

rows.description: How many attacked rows were read.

attacks.description: How many attacks were injected into the test logs.

hours.description: Hours of rows above `min_speed` with no attack in them, what the false alarms are counted over.

attacks_worth_catching.description: How many of them reach a row above `min_speed` and moved it by at least `moved`.
